entries.notes: 西语词头残损但仍可辨『Brozar el pan』（疑即 brotar el pan，发面/面团发起）之意，然汉字栏『花〔疑:伯/白〕目』与之无法对证，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 吐芽，抽芽；（树木枝条）发芽
entries.en: to bud, put forth sprouts (of a tree or bough)

entries.zh: 泉水涌出，泉源冒水；渗出
entries.en: (of spring water) to well up, gush forth from the spring; to seep

entries.zh: 发起来，发起（面团发酵发起；（草木）萌发长出）
entries.en: to rise up (as leavened dough); to sprout up

entries.zh: 发心，起心发愿（心中发起念愿）
entries.en: to set one's mind, to conceive a resolve (rouse the mind)
entries.notes: 汉字栏『發心』与西语『nazer el arbol（树长出）』语义不协，疑条目串位或西语侧讹写；释义从汉字与闽音栏。

entries.en: a turtle spirit, an animal turned sprite

entries.notes: 西语限定词 en〔疑:s/b〕ormoniado 之形义无法辨明，仅据汉字『怪』与闽、官两音定释义。

entries.en: a spirit in human form, human sprite
spirits and deities, ghosts and gods
entries.notes: 西语 melisica 一词形义不明，或为书手讹写；释义依汉字『鬼神』与两音栏。

entries.en: a tree spirit, sprite dwelling in a tree
to wash; scrub clean (and polish bright)
entries.notes: 汉字〔疑:洗/揉〕难以辨认，闽音 se 与『洗』相合（揉则不然），故定从『洗』。

entries.en: to grind, whet; rub and polish

entries.zh: 研油（灰），批灰磨墙；把墙面研光上油
entries.en: to putty and burnish a wall; rub putty/oil on a wall to shine it
entries.notes: 闽音栏 gue iūg hūi 后夹西语 un pared，『研油』当指研油灰（iû-hoe，批墙料）磨光墙壁，hūi 对字未定。
